sentences.text: It has been contended by learned counsel for the applicants that dispute alleged in the first information report is between mother and son.
He next submits that as per the allegation in the first information report, applicants got sale-deed in their favour without giving sale consideration to informant (mother).
He next contended that applicants and opposite party no. 2 have amicably settled their dispute out of court and entered into a compromise.
A copy of the compromise deed entered into between the parties has been annexed as Annexure-4 to the application.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the facts.
5. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order and compromise deed on the next date fixed.

It is therefore expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
It shall be open to the applicants to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of five weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.

Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Aditya  Nisar Mohammad And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132488133/
